_note: Probably Up to Date: bare previs of the scholars' coast libraries (set 'libraries'). No cast: the image pass adds the people; each note is the picture's brief.

cover.note: A seaside library on the coast at mid-morning: a small plastered building with a columned porch above the water. A courier in a short tunic is just setting off along the path with a sealed scroll case, and a reader waits at the door.

p01-keeper.note: One of a work's three keepers seen from its porch road. A reader stands at the door asking the librarian for a work; behind him a courier waits for the reply to carry.

p02-coast.note: The coast from the air: libraries scattered among olive groves and joined by footpaths. Three of them keep the same work; couriers on the paths carry editions and replies between them.

p03-seaside.note: A library whose road is long: a courier arrives at its porch with an edition after a long walk, while a reader inside has already been answered from the old copy.

p04-door.note: A reader leaves a library with an answer, not knowing whether the edition he was handed is the newest; behind him a late courier comes up the path with another reply.
